auditScope.title: Abandoned CPU Reference fixture and test expectation completion
auditScope.includedRecordRange: All 123 structured fixture rows were reviewed: 28 rows already represented by abandoned-reference-core and the remaining 95 rows reviewed here. All 223 it/test cases across four root specs and ten stage specs, plus the two assigned root helpers, were reviewed. Atomic entries below retain only physics-relevant or CPU-Reference-validation declarations; repeated assertions are represented once and related to their existing semantic owners.

fails loudly for unknown stage ids
fixture path discovery, JSON loading, id indexing, and accessor error handling
explicitExclusions.reason: Stage-registry shape, helper construction, generic prerequisite dispatch, and test-harness orchestration are implementation mechanics rather than physics or proof of the CPU Reference. Physics-bearing assertions in the same files remain included below.

These cases do not independently validate a physics value or numerical Reference result.

auditScope.authorityBoundary: A fixture or test file proves only that an expectation is declared. No assigned file is an identified execution record, no expectation passed status is inferred, and the abandoned lane is not target-Reference or scientific authority.
auditScope.lineageRule: Every citation is against frozen source snapshot SNAPSHOT-REPO-000001 at revision 514d5f6080d2dd485efdb07b5da9a203357a40c0. Source-shaped rows remain candidate or transitional until their external identity and derivation are independently verified.

nonClaims: The fixture and consuming spec prove that an expectation exists, not that the test executed or passed.
The abandoned implementation and locally transcribed derivation do not prove target CPU Reference correctness.
blockers: No pinned execution record or independently audited target-Reference comparison accompanies this declaration.
shared.nextAction: Verify the cited derivation independently and execute an equivalent test against a pinned target CPU Reference.
